## Package "prelink" Must not be Installed

The `prelink` package can be removed with the following command:
 
```
 $ apt-get remove prelink
```

**Rationale:**

The use of the `prelink` package can interfere with the operation of AIDE since it binaries.
Prelinking can also increase damage caused by vulnerability in a common library like libc.

steps.name: Package "prelink" Must not be Installed
steps.shell:
if [[ -f /usr/sbin/prelink ]];
then
prelink -ua
fi

# check wether the package is virtual: if not, remove it.
# if the package is virtual, iterate on providers
#  if a provider is installed, remove it
is_virtual=`apt-cache showpkg "prelink" | grep -Pzc 'Versions: \n\n'`
if [ $is_virtual = 1 ]; then
    rprovides_line=`apt-cache showpkg "prelink" | grep -n 'Reverse Provides:' | cut -f1 -d:`
    pkglist=`apt-cache showpkg "prelink" | tail -n +$(($rprovides_line + 1)) | cut -f1 -d' '`
    for package in $pkglist; do
        not_installed=`apt-cache policy $package | grep -c 'Installed: (none)'`
	if [ $not_installed = 0 ]; then
	    DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get -o DPkg::Lock::Timeout=60 remove -y $package
	fi
    done
else
    DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get -o DPkg::Lock::Timeout=60 remove -y "prelink"
fi
